deadline.value: Applications received by December 15, 2026 (11:59 pm PST) get preference for admission and funding; later ones only if space remains.
deadline.quote: Preference is given to applications for admission and financial support that are received by December 15, 11:59 p.m. Pacific Standard Time. Applications received after the deadline are considered on a space available basis.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are no longer accepted.
gre_general.quote: Official GRE scores No longer accepted for applications.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contact faculty you want to work with before applying and name them in your statement of purpose.
supervisor.quote: contact the faculty they are interested in working with before they submit an application

also.quote: In your statement of purpose, indicate which faculty member you are interested in working with.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are funded via RA/TA, departmental support and fellowships, but assistantships are limited and competitive.
funding.quote: Full-time Ph.D. students are responsible for covering their student fees, but they receive full funding through research or teaching assistantships, departmental support and fellowships from a variety of organizations. | Funding for research and teaching assistantships is limited, and awards are made on a competitive basis by departmental faculty in each research area.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's is the minimum, but PhD applicants typically already have a previous CEE degree and research experience.
entry_route.quote: Ph.D. applicants typically have a previous degree and research experience in civil and environmental engineering. | applicants must hold a baccalaureate degree from a regionally accredited college or university in the United States, its equivalent from a foreign institution
